app.name: Shopware CLI
app.one_liner: A command-line companion for managing Shopware 6 accounts, extensions, and projects.

screens.name: Main Terminal Interface
screens.purpose: Provides access to all CLI command groups (account, extension, project) via terminal input.

rust_commands.name: account_login
rust_commands.purpose: Authenticate user with Shopware account credentials.

rust_commands.name: extension_build
rust_commands.purpose: Build and validate Shopware extensions with custom PHP linting support.

rust_commands.name: project_create
rust_commands.purpose: Create new Shopware projects with staging mode and environment flag support.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add extension build and validation pipeline
week 1: Implement core account authentication flow
week 1: Support basic project creation with configuration flags
acceptance_tests: Extension builds succeed with custom PHP version specification
Project creation respects staging mode and environment flags (Elasticsearch, AMQP)
Telemetry events are emitted during upgrade checks without breaking core functionality
User can log in to Shopware account via CLI
